subject: Availability assertion: confirmation of downtime window, credit eligibility, and postmortem coordination
messages:
From: Eliot Shaw <eliot@fastserve.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, ops+incidents@fastserve.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service interruption 2026-08-15 22:10-22:45 UTC — confirmation and credit request

Hi Vivek,

We observed an elevated rate of 503s and timeouts against Redwood's text-generation endpoint between ~22:10 and ~22:45 UTC on 2026-08-15. This impacted two of our checkout paths and caused a measurable revenue drop for that 35-minute window.

Quick facts:
- Host: api.redwood-inference.com/usw2
- Endpoint: /v1/generate (model: rdw-large-v1)
- Local observed failure spike: 22:12 — 22:41 UTC (approx)
- User impact: ~12% increase in checkout failures during the window, estimated $8.6k lost GMV

Please confirm whether Redwood's telemetry shows an availability gap during that interval, whether this qualifies under the SLA for a remedial credit, and what evidence you need from our side. We can share traces and a condensed list of failed request IDs (attached) if that helps.

Also requesting a quick postmortem invite so we can understand root cause and mitigation steps — preferably this week UTC-friendly.

Thanks,
Eliot
Eliot Shaw
Senior SRE, FastServe
ops+incidents@fastserve.com

Hi Eliot — thanks for the report and the traces. I've looped in Rachel (SRE) and Laura (Account Ops) so we can take timeline/credit work in parallel.

Initial ask from our side:
- Can you confirm the list of affected customer tenant IDs and a conservative failure-rate window (start/end) you want us to validate?
- If you have a small sample of request IDs (10–20) that consistently show 503s/timeouts, please point us at them — that speeds the evidence pull.

We will:
- Pull our ingress/service telemetry for 22:00–23:00 UTC and validate error rates by region/model.
- Provide a preliminary window confirmation within 48 hours.
- If the window meets the SLA availability threshold for remedial credits, Laura will outline the credit calculation and timeline.

I'll follow up with the preliminary findings and a calendar invite for a postmortem. If you prefer an earlier sync, propose two time slots (we're UTC-friendly Tue/Wed).

—Vivek

Eliot — following our telemetry reconciliation and an initial service-side trace pull, here's the preliminary position.

Findings (prelim):
- Redwood ingress/error belt shows a focused error-rate spike correlated with your sample request ids between 2026-08-15T22:12:14Z and 2026-08-15T22:41:09Z.
- The spike caused elevated 503s for the cluster serving rdw-large-v1 in us-west-2 during that interval.
- We see a network-side circuit that experienced transient queue saturation while an autoscaler cycle was in progress; the condition resolved without degraded throughput after ~22:41 UTC.

Conclusion and next steps:
- Confirmed downtime window for adjudication: 2026-08-15T22:12:14Z -> 2026-08-15T22:41:09Z (this will be used for SLA remedy evaluation).
- Per the contract SLA (monthly uptime > 99.95%), this window exceeds the per-tenant availability threshold and is eligible for a proportional remedial credit.
- Laura will calculate the pro-rata credit using the standard formula and share an itemized worksheet. Expect the draft credit calculation by EOD Thu 2026-08-20.
- We will run a short postmortem (target attendees: Redwood SRE, Product Ops; FastServe SRE, Account Ops). Proposed meeting: Wed 2026-08-18 09:00 UTC (you proposed this — locking it unless you ask to change). Invite attached: postmortem-invite.ics
- Evidence bundle: redwood_prelim_window_snapshot.json (attached) and the raw traces you provided are in the shared Drive link above. We will produce a full log bundle and RCAs within 5 business days.

What we need from FastServe to finalize:
- Approval to proceed with the proportional credit calculation using the confirmed window above. Reply with "approve credit calc" if OK.
- Any additional business impact notes you want reflected in the postmortem (revenue figures, downstream partner impact).

We'll flag this to Legal/Finance after you approve the calculation and route the credit as a bill adjustment or account credit per your preference.

Thanks for the quick collaboration — we'll follow up with the calculation and the calendar invite confirmation.

—Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
